scenario: A debugging module is installed with default configuration; its event handler logs full prompts and tool payloads to the telemetry provider to ease troubleshooting.

given.observed behavior: records raw prompts and tool payloads by default

reasons: content capture is off by default on every surface; hashes and references carry the audit trail
the module exceeded its declared data access, which is a contract violation independent of intent
enabling content capture requires per-class consent with declared redaction, retention, and access
must_not: excuse the capture as debugging convenience
remediate by redacting stored content on read instead of preventing persistence
keep the already-captured content outside retention and access rules while the module is fixed
